title: Radio Presenter & Content Creator
company: New radio station launching in Dar es Salaam
description: About us

A brand-new radio station is launching soon in Dar es Salaam. It is news-heavy and business-oriented, designed for both young and older audiences. The station is looking for multi-talented storytellers, creators and sharp minds who can present on air and produce for digital platforms.
Role summary
Multi-Talented Radio Presenter & Content Creator. You will be the voice, the producer and the digital engine of your show, working both in front of the microphone and behind the scenes.
Key responsibilities
- On-air presentation: host engaging, mature and business-savvy radio programmes that resonate with young adults and older audiences.
- Multimedia production: shoot video, capture high-quality audio and edit both into content for social media and digital platforms.
- Content generation: research, write and produce original programme segments, business features and accurate news pieces.
- Technical execution: handle basic camera operations and audio-visual equipment.
Requirements

- A degree or diploma. Mass Communication or Journalism is welcome, but you must also have a qualification or deep expertise in a second discipline, ideally Business, Economics, Law, Finance, IT/Technology or Political Science.
- Proven ability in on-air presentation, audio/video editing, camera operation and script/news writing.
- Able to speak with authority to seasoned professionals while staying relatable to a younger audience.
- Deep familiarity with the culture, history, trends and financial pulse of Dar es Salaam.
What we offer
- Be part of a new radio station launch in Tanzania's media capital.
- A modern studio environment.
- Creative freedom to shape multi-generational programming and your own digital brand.
- Competitive compensation.
How to apply
Send your application by email to amarage255@gmail.com with the subject line "The Media Unicorn - [Your Name]". Include:
1. Your portfolio: links to your showreel, an audio demo, a video you have edited, or articles/news pieces you have written.
2. Your resume, highlighting your dual-discipline education and technical skills.
Deadline: 21 October 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for studio auditions. The employer states it is an equal opportunity employer.
